integrity: The proof independently rederives the classical sharp Euclidean one-step gradient bound, combines it with exact-line-search gradient orthogonality, and gives a simultaneous equality construction. A standalone standard-library checker replays the construction and the three-dimensional witness. The earlier Euclidean gradient-norm theorem is explicitly credited as prior work rather than claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic one-step theorem for ordinary Euclidean steepest descent with exact line search on real SPD quadratics, with the gradient measured in the coordinatewise maximum norm. It does not classify multi-step path maxima, inexact line searches, nonquadratic objectives, finite precision, or structurally restricted Hessian classes.
title: Sharp max-norm gradient frontier for exact-line-search steepest descent
